mods.name: commit-nudge
mods.description: Suggests a commit at turn end after 8 or more file edits since the last git commit. One toast per batch of edits; a successful git commit resets the count.

mods.name: todo-nudge
mods.description: At turn end, one toast with the count of TODO, FIXME and HACK lines your edits added this turn. Quiet when none were added.

mods.name: break-nudge
mods.description: Suggests a short break once the session has run 90 minutes, and again every 90 minutes after that.

mods.name: docs-nudge
mods.description: At turn end, one toast when edits added exported code (an export statement in .ts or .js, or a public function signature) and no README or docs file was edited this session.

mods.name: debug-print-nudge
mods.description: At turn end, one toast naming the count of console.log, print(, debugger and dbg! lines your edits added this turn. Only code files count.

mods.name: focus-pack
mods.description: Three quiet nudges in one mod: commit after 8 edits, TODO/FIXME/HACK lines added, and debug prints added.
